### Qualified current-revision assessment

The latest description clarifies the four-layer warning cleanup and the dual compilation constraint: payload code is compiled by the test project and Windows PowerShell 5.1 Add-Type. The source head is unchanged. The unavailable clipboard observation still uses an empty digest internally while EndpointWorker keeps the serialized unavailable digest null; Available remains the deciding state. The private constructor and actual digest producers preserve non-null values.

The TaskCompletionSource path has one exception producer. The retained single-exception probe and source trace do not establish lost sibling exceptions, so flattening is not a required correction. The process/session lookup pattern already existed in the parent and is not a measured regression introduced by this nullable-only layer.

The author's expanded description reports a local project build without nullable warnings, PowerShell 5.1 compilation/runtime probes, two focused tests and 89 non-launch preparation checks. These are attributed author results, not independent execution by this reassessment; the author explicitly did not run Sandbox E2E.

No additional required code correction is established in the accumulated source/caller scope. This is not fresh zero-finding approval or independent complete build/Sandbox/runtime signoff. The later stack layers still own the remaining analyzer/style warnings and warnings-as-errors override.
